Second term: ​ -2i(2i \cdot 3 - 2 \cdot 3) = -2i(6i - 6) = 12 + 12i ​. Third term: ​ 1(2i \cdot 1 - 3i \cdot 3) = 2i - 9i = -7i ​. Sum: ​(-9 + 12) + (-2 + 12 - 7)i = 3 + 3i ​. So ​Z = \frac{1}{3}(3 + 3i) = 1 + i ​. Its modulus is ​\sqrt{1^2 + 1^2} = \sqrt{2} ​. Answer: ​\sqrt{2} ​. Correct option: B (\(\sqrt{2}\)).
